description.overview: As a Property Manager, you will play a key role in strengthening our Real Estate operations within the Real Estate space.

Modern office with free lunch and snacks
Competitive salary reviewed twice a year
responsibilities: Oversee end-to-end core real estate activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Define and manage day-to-day operations related to the role, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Set direction and KPIs for continuous improvement initiatives and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.

Define and manage stakeholder communication and updates, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Oversee end-to-end a team of professionals, setting clear goals and supporting their development.
Set direction and KPIs for documentation and knowledge sharing in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: 6+ years of experience, including 2-3 years in a management role relevant to the Property Manager role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

benefits.label: Parking allowance / shuttle bus support
Opportunity to work with international partners
Holiday and Tet bonus

Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Sponsored gym membership and sport clubs
